summary: On March 5, 2026 Station Casinos LLC of Las Vegas discovered that an unauthorized third party had accessed a single employee's account and associated files. The company said its properties and operations were not affected. It sent written notices on May 21, 2026, reported the incident to the Maine attorney general as an external system breach (hacking), and offered 12 months of identity theft protection; the number of people affected was not disclosed.
